description: Main source file for a Zephyr-based multi-core IP header validation simulation, involving thread management, queue processing, and CRC validation.

methods.name: init_datagram_queue
methods.description: Initializes a sender packet header queue with random data and CRCs.

methods.name: test_thread
methods.description: Processes packets from sender to receiver queue, validating CRCs.

methods.name: queue_thread
methods.description: Manages thread creation for processing queue pairs and synchronization.

methods.name: main
